description: Power shortcut: create a whole website in ONE call and configure it. Only use this when the user clearly wants it done fast ("just build it for me") and has given a business name + type + country — otherwise prefer the guided one-question-at-a-time flow. It creates the site (from templateId if given, else a blank project of projectType), then best-effort applies country/currency/payments, contact settings, and navigation, and returns the preview URL plus a publish prompt. Steps that fail do not abort the build — each is reported in the steps array. Does NOT publish unless publish=true.

contactAddress.description: Business address shown on the site.

contactPhone.description: Business phone shown on the site.

country.description: ISO country code, e.g. "ZA", "US", "GB", "NG". Auto-sets currency/language and recommends payment providers.

projectType.description: Used when no templateId is given.

provider.description: Payment provider to activate. API keys are still entered in the dashboard.

publish.description: When true, publish the site live at the end. Default false so the user can preview first.

syncNavigation.description: Rebuild navigation from the created pages.

templateId.description: Template id from list_templates. If omitted, a blank project is created — prefer picking a template first for a better result.

name: quick_build
